uv: World-scale UVs: 1 UV unit = 1 metre on the surface. Walls: u = metres along the wall (to the right when facing it), v = metres up from the floor. Floors and ceilings: u = x, v = z in the house's local frame. Roofs: u along the eaves, v up the slope. The library divides by each material's 'scale' (metres per tile, [u, v]) and flips v so pictures read upright; 'rotate' (degrees) turns the pattern on the surface (floorboards across a room, vertical boards on a wall). Props keep their own glTF UVs (scale 1).
